subject: Medford High Gay-Straight Alliance Pride Interview
overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed Medford High School GSA officer Lila D'Antonio about the organization's role in supporting LGBTQ+ students and its advocacy work within the school district. The conversation highlighted curriculum reform efforts, school climate issues, and upcoming citywide Pride celebrations.

items.title: Introduction and Pride Announcements
items.summary: The host announced Medford Pride events, including a flag raising ceremony at City Hall scheduled for June 2nd.

items.title: GSA Mission and Activities
items.summary: Lila D'Antonio described the Medford High School GSA as a student-led safe space that hosts weekly meetings and educational events for queer students.

items.title: School Activism and Assemblies
items.summary: The GSA organizes an annual assembly for freshmen to set expectations against homophobic behavior and collaborates with regional advocacy groups like BAGLY and PFLAG.

items.title: School Climate and Discrimination
items.summary: D'Antonio noted instances of mural vandalism and student-led misgendering at the high school while observing that most teachers are supportive.

items.title: Health and Sex Education Curriculum Reform
items.summary: GSA officers participated in a student focus group to advocate for more queer-inclusive language and comprehensive content in the district's health curriculum.

items.title: Mental Health Supports
items.summary: The organization provides peer support and links to professional mental health resources through a digital classroom platform to assist students facing depression or isolation.

items.title: GSA Leadership and Governance
items.summary: The club operates with five equal officers elected by the membership to ensure distributed responsibility and a student-led focus.

items.title: Citywide Pride and Community History
items.summary: D'Antonio discussed the transition from GSA-led youth pride parades during the pandemic to participating in larger citywide celebrations and flag raisings.

items.title: Queer History and Educational Resources
items.summary: The interview concluded with recommendations for learning about queer history through specific books and podcasts.
